scope: Finite CPU-only synthetic receiving-adapter validation and source/contract review
method: Independent original-GLB accessor decoder and independent analytic rotation/error expectations; no adapter matching/numerical helpers as oracle
notes: Public API names may be adapted to the agreed schema without changing required behavior.
Some malformed structural inputs may be refused instead of returned as per-corner invalid; the final adopted contract must specify this consistently.
This plan does not authorize native receiving or certify original held C211 native output.
Source review controls C36-C40 are distinct from executable numeric/schema controls.

controls.expected: Independently decode original GLB indices/accessors; construct Blender-frame local positions and normals for all 18 instances, reorder triangles/cyclic corners, map all 7,800 triangle instances and 23,400 corners back to exact source identity.
Asymmetric signed vectors prove inverse rotation (X,Y,Z)->(X,Z,-Y); orientation-preserving cyclic order maps correctly and reversed winding does not become accepted observed rows.
Perturb normal values with source positions unchanged; mapped source identities remain fixed and component/angular errors match independently computed values.
Negate a mapped direction; angle is 180 degrees, full denominator retained, no shading acceptance or tolerance inferred.
Scale a mapped direction; component differences remain visible even if angular difference is zero.
Remove an otherwise mapped triangle; its source corners remain missing and counts sum to all expected corners.
No native triangles yields full missing denominator; maxima are null rather than zero.
Null, bool, string, wrong length, zero and nonfinite normal vectors produce invalid observations or strict structural refusal under documented contract; never zero-loss observed values.
A triangle containing valid and invalid normals preserves valid measurements and separately reports invalid corners.
Repeat a claimed native object/triangle/corner identity; reject or explicitly flag invalid/ambiguous without overwriting observations.
Two native records mapping to the same source triangle remain ambiguous; no arbitrary first/last winner.
Coincident/repeated possible source mappings are reported ambiguous or refused; observed normals cannot disambiguate.
Change one local position beyond declared mapping policy; no nearest-triangle guessing or successful native evidence.
Swap two triangle corners; reflected winding does not match an orientation-preserving source triangle.
Shared mesh instances retain node and source identity; swapping native object labels cannot silently merge instance observations.
Unknown source identity, node or unsupported mesh/primitive references are refused or reported without dropping the source denominator.
Bool/negative/string identifiers, malformed corners and nonunique corner identifiers are refused under the exact schema.
Coincident positions with different source-corner normals stay separate; no position welding or normal averaging.
Modified winding, normal sign/bytes, corner identity or payload schema is refused against unchanged accepted triple.
Byte mutation/whitespace change in each accepted input is refused; a self-consistent but unaccepted replacement cannot become authority.
Observation source-payload digest mismatch is refused.
Accepted source triple and revision must be bound transitively or explicitly; altered declarations cannot be silently accepted.
Changing receiver/source or executable/importer build identities without updating the independently locked context is refused.
Changing import/extraction settings without matching exact locked settings is refused.
When a scene is supplied, scene bytes/hash/size and observation claims must agree; absent scene remains explicitly absent, never invented save/reopen evidence.
Unknown kind/profile/schema/empty producer and hidden acceptance fields are refused; a native-labeled envelope cannot establish actual execution/fidelity from declarations alone.
World-space, left-handed, unknown or nonunit/transformed-frame claims are refused rather than guessed.
Strict reader rejects duplicate members and unsupported schema fields; nonstandard NaN/Infinity JSON cannot bypass numeric checks.
Admitted extreme finite directions produce stable angular measurement and honest raw component differences; unrepresentable values are explicitly invalid/refused.
Source authoritative normal bytes and signed-zero distinctions remain unchanged; frame conversion affects only observations.
Observed/missing/ambiguous/invalid counts sum to expected source corners; excluded/invalid observations never lower the denominator or supply a false zero maximum.
Even complete zero-loss synthetic copy has native fidelity and receiving evidence false, no adopted tolerance and shading/receiving acceptance unevaluated.
C214 source and public synthetic-only behavior remain byte-identical; C214 continues to refuse native observation kind.
Permuting native record order and orientation-preserving triangle rotations changes no source mapping/measurement; stable repeat output with fixed inputs.

Report retains exact input payload/observations/receiver-build-settings/scene digest references and unmodified source-corner normal authority; reported digests recompute from actual bytes/canonical rules.
Static source/API review confirms isolated stdlib CPU adapter with no Blender, source compiler, exporter, external dependency/network or hidden execution.
Contract selects exact retained source plus separately observed native shading/disclosed loss without adopting approximation; original C211 strict failure and unrun gates remain unchanged.
